package_normalizations: Printed ● subheading markers, ・/• bullet glyphs and the ❶–❸ inbox numbers are drawn by the shared theme (h3 marker, list marker, numbered inbox cards), so the characters are not repeated in the text.
Side-label boxes (ご注意, 充電に関する安全上のご注意) become shared caution callouts carrying the printed label; the label's print line wrap (「充電に関する安 / 全上のご注意」) is not kept.
Superscript marks printed small (最大550W±50W①, USB Type-C® / USB-C®) are kept as the same characters at text size.
Print case is kept: Latin words in headings and specification titles are not upper-cased on the Web (source geometry rule).
The 警告/注意 table pictograms repeat the 絵表示の説明 legend and are not repeated per item; the ⚠ beside ご注意 is drawn by the shared caution callout.
normalizations: Outlined PDF: original.pdf has no text layer; every Japanese line is a manual transcription from 300-500 dpi renders, kept as printed (source/intake.py names the physical pages of each chapter). No Japanese wording, punctuation, full-width/half-width form or number is changed; suspected source errors are listed in source_concerns.

Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components. No package class or inline style; plain tables are declared in shared_component_exceptions (prepared-document shared-style gate).
Print weights: bold print runs stay strong; printed bullet and number marks become lists; sub-items nest under their item. Printed ※ and ①-style marks stay in the text.
Line ends inside a Japanese paragraph are wraps and are joined without a space; the print's explicit line breaks inside one block stay line breaks.
Figures are source panels cropped from original.pdf at 4x; words drawn in the art stay in the art and the alt text carries them.

Superscript marks printed small (最大550W±50W①, USB Type-C® / USB-C®) are kept as the same characters at text size.
